body:

Still 14KB. Let me compress further with tighter citations and a shorter code fence.

I need far more aggressive compression. Let me rewrite as a terse fact sheet with one citation per claim.

Let me write a leaner version, offloading detail into the required tables.

Let me apply all the trims in one final rewrite.

Byte band achieved (7,501). Let me verify the citation format is compatible with the verifier.

The verifier's token regex rejects comma-separated ranges and leading-dot paths. Let me fix all citations to single ranges.
